use_cases: Displaying confirmation dialogs for user actions like delete or submit operations
Showing detailed information or forms that require focused attention
Presenting alerts and notifications that interrupt the current workflow
Capturing user input through embedded forms within the modal content
Revealing contextual information or help content without leaving the current page
ai_summary: An animated dialog component built with Framer Motion that provides smooth scale and opacity transitions for opening and closing. Features scroll prevention on iOS, controlled/uncontrolled state management, and accessibility-focused context with unique IDs for title and description elements. Designed as a reusable overlay primitive suitable for various industry applications.
